nodes.summary: Hardy, Bergman, Dirichlet and Fock spaces and their reproducing kernels, H^∞, boundary behaviour (Fatou, F. and M. Riesz), cyclicity and polynomial density.
nodes.title: Spaces of analytic functions

nodes.summary: Contour integrals, Cauchy's theorem, residues, argument principle, Rouché, Laurent series, isolated singularities (Casorati–Weierstrass, great Picard), Schwarz reflection, Looman–Menchoff, normal families and local properties of holomorphic functions on discs and annuli.
nodes.title: Complex integration, residues and singularities

nodes.summary: Growth and value distribution of entire and meromorphic functions: Wiman–Valiron theory and maximum term, Hayman admissibility, Weierstrass factorization, Mittag-Leffler, Liouville-type rigidity, preimages and zeros/ones on lines.
nodes.title: Entire and meromorphic functions

nodes.summary: Conformal and univalent maps: Riemann mapping, Koebe and Bloch theorems, Schwarz–Pick and half-plane self-maps, starlike and univalent coefficient problems, Loewner equation, holomorphic motions.
nodes.title: Geometric function theory

nodes.summary: Holomorphic functions on C^n: Hartogs extension and separate analyticity, Weierstrass preparation, complex Hessians.
nodes.title: Several complex variables

nodes.summary: Analytic behaviour of complex polynomials: location of zeros (Eneström–Kakeya, Sendov's problem, Jentzsch), flat and Littlewood polynomials, complementary polynomials and sup norms on the unit circle. Algebraic properties of polynomials go to Algebra; Mahler measure goes to NumberTheory.
nodes.title: Polynomials in the complex plane

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
